🤖 NEW: TITAN UPDATE! The OMEGA TITAN stomps, fires its eye laser and missiles, and gets ENRAGED when hurt. Team up and bring it down for a huge payout!
☢️ NUKE THE CITY straight from the missile silo at spawn!
⚔️ PVP: turn it on and fight other villains for cash. Spawn is always safe.
⚡ POWERS: Thunder God, Meteor Storm & Orbital Laser. Try any of them FREE!

😈 Become the villain and DESTROY EVERYTHING
✈️ Fly over a huge city and smash buildings to pieces
🚓 Take on police, helicopters, tanks & jets
💰 Earn cash, buy upgrades and rank up to GOD OF RUIN
🏰 Your lair earns cash even while you're offline

🎮 Powers: 1 / 2 on PC • L2 / L1 on console • tap the buttons on mobile
⭐ Favorite & 👍 Like for more updates!
